production_scope: Only the already-materialized ordered membership predicate; no SQL/hash/eligibility/seen/timestamp/lease/cancellation/deadline changes

synthetic_measurements.reference: old tuple construction plus internal index scan
synthetic_measurements.candidate: actual production helper, length equality plus indexed ID/index scan
synthetic_measurements.memory_pass: one separate tracemalloc peak invocation per implementation after timings, not RSS or preexisting input storage

decision: Retain only if semantic guards pass and both predeclared rounds have lower traced peak bytes and candidate/reference timing median <=1.10. This pragmatic local threshold is not a statistical guarantee. Do not select an extra favorable round; revert production candidate if unsupported, preserving negative evidence and useful membership tests

real_smoke.meaning: actual full-catalog identity/HTTP smoke only, not API A/B, stable concurrency, original orphan reproduction or browser acceptance

source: same clean tracked code/plan checkpoint; commit and tracked hashes before/after each measurement
stop: No auto rerun. Preserve startup/transport/HTTP/config/integrity/cleanup failures; check exact owned schema removal and listener exit. Successful smoke does not replace previous3/32timeouts
protected: primary checkout restored clean after known two-file agent misrouting; .env unchanged; no restart or probe of user8000; business model not published or migrated
